# ractermx_blocklist_entry (Resource)

Manages a RacterMX sender blocklist entry.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Block all email from a specific sender domain.
resource "ractermx_blocklist_entry" "block_spam_domain" {
  pattern = "*@spam.example.com"
}

# Block a specific sender address.
resource "ractermx_blocklist_entry" "block_sender" {
  pattern = "phishing@malicious.example.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `pattern` (String) The sender email pattern to block (e.g., 'spam@example.com' or '*@spam.com'). Changing this forces a new resource.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) The timestamp when the blocklist entry was created.
- `id` (Number) The numeric ID of the blocklist entry.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import a blocklist entry using its numeric ID.
terraform import ractermx_blocklist_entry.block_spam_domain 42
```
